label: RSO-GEN5-CUMULATIVE-DISCOVERY
title: Observatory generation 5: from mechanism attribution to cumulative discovery (Aether replay audit, Ananke/Crius selection gates, acquisition-to-composition assay, adversarial kit)
objective: Directive s12 completion items 1-10: Aether post-confirmation replay audit with a bounded result; replay erratum; explicit selection disposition for Ananke and Crius; one selected or both rejected; deterministic adversarial kit tested; any selected assay frozen with controls; independent Q3 challenge or its missing qualification recorded; bounded native pilot if qualification permits; limitations preserved; closeout naming the next decisive experiment.

Q1.description: low-ambiguity / mechanical: CI wiring, manifests, schemas following a settled design, repetitive fixtures, generated docs, deterministic wrappers, simple adapters, mechanical refactors under strong tests

Q2.description: substantial engineering: subsystem design inside a frozen contract, complex TDD, state machines, evidence graphs, runtime adapters, reset/restart machinery, integration, complex debugging

Q3.description: scarce deep reasoning / adversarial: adversarial test design, epistemic ambiguity, counterfeit construction, cross-physics abstraction attacks, difficult first-sight review, failures that survived strong Q2 attempts

caps.local_compute: local fleet only; harry1 CPU preferred; do not reserve the M2 GPU; no large evolutionary search; any longer run proposed separately (directive s11)
caps.isolation: Aether/, roles/Aether/, crius/, roles/Crius/, prometheus/ananke/, roles/Ananke/ read-only; Ananke owns its native search physics and FLIP experiments (coordination required before any experiment that could duplicate or interfere); Crius seat not reopened (Cadmus = temporary read-only compatibility steward); nothing run on M2; pinned SHAs; no change to C-018 frozen files or its decision rule

disposition.result: CLOSED EARLY on the selection gate (directive s9): Aether post-confirmation audit 57/57 MATCH (8/8 CONFIRMED replayed; erratum E1); Crius WORLD_DEMAND_NOT_QUALIFIED (frozen rule 4/5 vs 5/5; leaks inert) + DISCOVERY_INACCESSIBLE; Ananke not selectable in-window (owner silent since 2026-10-09, C5T unreported, constructed positive 2/32 needs 107/arm); adversarial kit (0 SURVIVED); Ananke read-only oracle evaluator + parts-suitability prereg DRAFT (owner sign-off); no Gen-5 assay, no Q3, no pilot
disposition.next: C5T outcome from Ananke; consent for oracle re-evaluation; budget-calibration stage (owner, ~26 GPU-h) before any reuse comparison
